name: AssistantBench
protocol: AssistantBench fixed 214-task release; this series uses one result per underlying model from the HAL Browser-Use verified export. Scaffold, model configuration, and full-run cost remain in observation notes; no configurations are silently merged.

explanation.en: Accuracy is the fraction of the fixed 214 tasks answered correctly under the published Browser-Use evaluation export. Full-run costs shown by the source are not treated as per-task cost.
explanation.zh: Accuracy 是在公开 Browser-Use evaluation export 中答对固定 214 个 task 的比例。来源展示的 full-run cost 不会被当作 per-task cost。

summary.en: AssistantBench evaluates web-capable assistants on realistic, time-consuming tasks that require multi-step research across the internet.
summary.zh: AssistantBench 评估具备网页能力的 assistant 完成真实、耗时且需要多步互联网 research 的 task 的能力。

task_format.en: The agent receives a real-world question and must browse across websites, gather evidence, reason over it, and submit a final answer.
task_format.zh: agent 会收到一个真实世界问题，需要跨网站浏览、收集证据、进行推理，并提交最终答案。
